Block.Name: VG
Block.OrderByClause: color_id, (select z.sort_no from mm_size z where z.id = size_id)

RecordGroup.Name: RG_FIND
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, code, name from mm_item where is_model = 'Y' order by code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_NEWMODEL
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, code || ' ' || name text from mm_item where is_model = 'N' and parent_id is null and kit = 'N' and serial_tracked = 'N' order by code

RecordGroup.Name: RG_COLOR
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, name from mm_color order by name

RecordGroup.Name: RG_SIZE
RecordGroup.RecordGroupQuery: select id, size_group || ' ' || code text from mm_size order by size_group, sort_no
